# Input: 4x8 (excluding 5 separator)

    [0, 0, 0, 1, 2, 2, 2, 0],
    [1, 0, 0, 0, 0, 2, 2, 2],
    [1, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, 2, 2],
    [1, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, 2]
]

    [2, 2, 2, 1],
    [1, 2, 2, 2],
    [1, 1, 2, 2],
    [1, 1, 1, 2]
]

    print(row)
